cross_product_finding: Unlike Predictive Query, Delta Sync, and Database Encryption elsewhere in this batch, Vector Search carries NO Enterprise Edition gate on this page (no '[Enterprise Edition]' callout appears anywhere in vector-search.md) - it appears to be available regardless of edition, which is a genuine asymmetry in how CBL licenses its feature set (ML-integration features are split: Predictive Query is Enterprise-only, but Vector Search, which is also ML-adjacent, is not gated here). This is worth flagging for the coordinator since it contradicts an assumption that 'AI/ML features are Enterprise-gated' in Couchbase Lite.
notable_absence: No edition, version, or access-control gate found anywhere on this page - a second confirmation (after query-live.md) that not all CBL feature areas map onto the edition/version/privilege axes this stress test is probing.
